edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom trusts msg.sender to act as allowance owner and spends allowance[msg.sender].
approve writes allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
ensure evaluates _from which may be derived from the caller path.
delegate compares the caller against owner before delegatecall.
init compares the caller against owner before setting sale bounds.
batchSend compares the caller against owner before distributing balances.
setTradeAddress compares the caller against owner before writing tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns owner and full supply to the deploying msg.sender.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value).
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure computes the pair address through pairFor.
delegate performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath, underflow risk.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath, underflow risk.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath, overflow risk.
ensure whitelists _from or _to equal to owner.
delegate gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
init gates state writes on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend gates distribution on msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress gates the write on msg.sender == owner.
Constructor writes owner.
ensure whitelists _from equal to tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists _from flagged in canSale.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale limit.
condition reads _minSale as the lower sale bound.
condition reads _maxSale as the upper sale bound.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the owner and each recipient.
transferFrom checks and spends allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor sets totalSupply and credits it to the deployer.
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals.
Constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals.
_to is the transfer recipient forwarded to transferFrom.
_value is the transfer amount forwarded to transferFrom.
_value flows into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
_from is the source account mutated by transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_tos provides the recipient array and length used in batchSend.
a is the delegatecall target address in delegate.
b is the arbitrary calldata passed to delegatecall.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
token is scaled and stored into _minSale by init.
maxToken is scaled and stored into _maxSale by init.
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
_UNI holds the computed pair used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
total holds the unchecked product checked against balanceOf in batchSend.
i drives the batchSend distribution loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only flows into the transfer forwarding call; belongs to the transfer function node.
Amount parameter only affects the transfer call and its arithmetic; belongs to the transfer function node.
Source account parameter only drives the balance and allowance mutations of transferFrom.
Spender parameter is used solely as the allowance key in approve.
Recipient array parameter only feeds the batchSend loop and its length arithmetic.
Target address parameter is consumed only by the delegatecall inside delegate.
Calldata parameter is consumed only by the delegatecall inside delegate.
saleNum parameter is written only into _saleNum by init.
token parameter is scaled and written only into _minSale by init.
maxToken parameter is scaled and written only into _maxSale by init.
addr parameter is written only into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Computed pair local is used only for the whitelist comparison inside ensure.
Product local is used only for the balance check inside batchSend.
Loop index local exists only to drive the batchSend iteration.
